figures.caption: Figure 1: Two ways to turn an observation into an executable action. Top: a dual-process controller separates a language model for semantic planning from a pretrained motor policy for execution. VLA denotes a vision language action model; WAM denotes a world action model. Bottom: in the LLM-as-policy setting, the language model selects motion targets directly. Non-learned post-processing converts these targets into executable commands without a pretrained motor policy.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 1: 관측을 실행 가능한 행동으로 바꾸는 두 가지 방식. 위: 이중 과정 제어기는 의미적 계획을 담당하는 언어 모델과 실행을 담당하는 사전학습 운동 정책을 분리한다. VLA는 비전 언어 행동 모델, WAM은 세계 행동 모델이다. 아래: LLM-as-policy 설정에서는 언어 모델이 동작 목표를 직접 선택한다. 비학습 후처리가 사전학습 운동 정책 없이 이 목표를 실행 가능한 명령으로 변환한다.

figures.caption: Figure 2: The model-facing context and execution loop. A frozen language model chooses world-frame end-effector (EEF) targets at the grasp point through move_eef. The action conversion module is non-learned. It validates the request, converts grasp-point targets to flange poses, plans joint paths, and constructs executable joint commands. Requested gripper changes follow the arm-motion phase. The two return routes are the two branches of a request. A rejected target returns an error as the tool result and causes no motion, so the model retries against the same observation; this is the dashed route. An accepted target returns its planned duration, executes, and only then produces the next observation with the achieved state and arrival error; this is the solid route. give_up requests termination, but only the environment determines success. The context retains the latest two RGB frames from each camera.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 2: 모델이 받는 문맥과 실행 루프. 고정된 언어 모델은 move_eef를 통해 파지 지점의 월드 좌표계 말단장치(EEF) 목표를 선택한다. 행동 변환 모듈은 학습되지 않았다. 요청을 검증하고, 파지 지점 목표를 플랜지 자세로 변환하며, 관절 경로를 계획하고 실행 가능한 관절 명령을 구성한다. 요청된 그리퍼 변경은 팔 동작 이후에 수행한다. 두 반환 경로는 요청의 두 분기이다. 거절된 목표는 도구 결과로 오류를 반환하고 움직임을 일으키지 않으므로 같은 관측에서 재시도한다(점선). 수락된 목표는 계획 실행 시간을 반환하고 실행한 뒤, 도달 상태와 도착 오차를 포함한 다음 관측을 생성한다(실선). give_up은 종료를 요청하지만 성공은 환경만 판단한다. 문맥에는 각 카메라의 최근 두 RGB 프레임을 유지한다.

relations.note: The related-work section contrasts pretrained VLA action experts with a frozen LLM selecting motion targets.
Both investigate language-model-based manipulation through executable interfaces; this study emits EEF targets rather than synthesizing a skill library.

ai_summary.one_liner: A frozen GPT-6 Astra selects robot motion targets through non-learned conversion, leading a RoboDojo leaderboard snapshot while remaining weak at precise and dynamic manipulation.
ai_summary.problem: Can a general-purpose language model select executable manipulation targets without robot-specific fine-tuning or a pretrained motor policy?
ai_summary.solution: Closed-loop RGB and robot-state observations feed a frozen LLM that calls move_eef; non-learned validation, pose conversion and joint-path planning execute the requests.
ai_summary.key_result: Across 42 tasks and 2,100 Astra trials, leaderboard Average SR is 22.48% and Score 28.97 versus DM0.5 at 19.34% and 24.90; the public policies receive different task information.
limitations: Single seed and one principal simulator; public policy rows were a snapshot with non-equivalent input information.
Precision, dynamic control and coordinated bimanual manipulation remain weak; RGB and EEF interface limitations are confounded with model capability.
Real-robot evaluation stopped after unsafe actions and hardware damage; retained trials are diagnostic, not a completed benchmark.
Perturbation traces do not isolate adaptation, and the demonstration probe tests one insertion protocol.

research_gaps.question: Do within-episode corrections transfer across tasks and embodiments under controlled history and feedback ablations?
How much of the precision ceiling comes from RGB-only sensing and the EEF target interface rather than model reasoning?
Does the aggregate advantage survive equal task information, repeated seeds and matched time or inference budgets?

future_directions: Test correction transfer across tasks and embodiments with history, visual-feedback and motion-feedback ablations.
Repeat comparisons with equivalent task descriptions, multiple evaluation seeds and reported inference latency and cost.
Evaluate richer sensing and action interfaces to separate perception and motor-interface limits from model capability.
survey_hooks: benchmark input parity and deployment reliability
ai_research_question: When can a frozen general-purpose LLM select useful robot motion targets, and what prevents reliable precision control?
